name: Tamara Kurniawan
source:
Tamara, to put it simply, is a down-to-earth girl. Sarcastic and being blunt are her speciality, while she's very aware of her surroundings, she can be as dense as a brick when it's about herself. Her unique trait is often misunderstood by others.

"*sigh*I don't think anything will surprise me anymore."

"My innocence? It flew over the window when half-naked men are walking and flying all over the place!"

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=36078]lemmasoft[/url]]
